what_this_is: Every published fenced block, classified and cross-referenced against the execution registry, so the work that follows can tell a correct synopsis from a recipe nobody ran.

commands_with_no_executed_published_exam.means: No fenced block that this repository executes contains this command. It says nothing about whether the command is tested -- most are, in cmd/notriosctl's tests and in the I4, I7 and J3 drills. It says a reader of docs/ is shown the form and never shown it run.
